narrative_engine.thesis: trend up context (H4 stack up · D1 stack up · EMA spread 1.54 ATR · price holds above Day VWAP) set the LONG bias. Price pulled back into the confluence zone 3.547-3.678 (VWAP band · POC · EMA pocket · PDH/PDL flip), where the footprint printed its confirmation. Risk is defined beyond 3.525; the first objective pays 0.62R at 3.704.

plan.triggerRule: footprint abs fired buy in long direction at the zone (absorption inside the zone)
plan.invalidation: structure beyond 3.525 (signal zone / ±2σ VWAP / 0.5 ATR buffer)
